verdict.rationale: Kong, as evidenced here, is an API gateway and API management platform (Gateway, AI Gateway, Konnect, decK, Dev Portal, Catalog). Importing and exporting request collections between tools is an API-client capability, so this story is outside its product category. Nothing in the pack shows Kong shipping a collections or workspaces feature: decK's declarative gateway configuration and Dev Portal's OpenAPI publishing are not collection import/export.
